_doc: Recorded alert incidents replayed by tests/alert-replay.test.mts (#10976). Each wording is one row of shadow:score-log:v5 as production queued it: source label (often a topic feed, not the publisher), classifier label, edition (variant), publisher timestamp, the time the relay queued it (seenAt), corroboration count and logged score. expected is what should happen; knownMiss names the issue that should make an expected alert pass. Corroboration and source are frozen inputs here, so a fix that changes how production derives them leaves these scores unchanged and the pin stays green: the fix must replay its changed inputs through this set, and the entry is updated when the pin then fails. scoreNow, when present, is the score today's code gives because a later change moved it (for example a source tier), with the change in scoreNowBecause.
